text: Professional Overview：The Electronic Information Engineering major originated from the Radar Design and Manufacturing major established in 1953. During its development process, it has undergone multiple adjustments and integrations of its professional name. This major is based on the fundamental theories and skills of electronic information technology, guided by the theories of signal and information processing, takes computer hardware and software systems as the application platform, and aims to apply in fields such as signal and information processing, intelligent hardware, artificial intelligence, and smart perception.Training Objectives：Cultivate individuals who can adapt to the needs of social and economic development, possess moral and cultural qualities, a sense of social responsibility, an innovative spirit and entrepreneurial awareness, master the essential basic knowledge of mathematics and natural science as well as corresponding professional knowledge, have good learning ability, practical ability, professional ability and certain innovation and entrepreneurship ability, and be physically and mentally healthy. High-quality specialized talents who can be engaged in the research, design, development, manufacturing, application, maintenance and management of systems, equipment and devices in the field of electronic information and related areas.
